art_direction: 积雪梅枝斜穿画面，少量胭脂花与一只蓬松麻雀在中心相遇。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Paint a snow-covered plum branch entering from the lower left and bending upward around a small resting sparrow. Place the bird near the central crossing of branches, with a rounded warm-gray body and a few precise feather marks. Scatter a limited cluster of muted carmine blossoms beside it, leaving other twigs bare under the snow. Combine soft pooled ink in the bark with sharp branch tips and delicate snow edges. Keep the background a quiet blue-gray winter wash rather than a detailed landscape. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
